entries.prompt: Repaint the same fictional game character Hachi from reference 1 with believable human facial anatomy and realistic materials with a restrained hand-painted finish, matching the natural skin/hair rendering quality of reference 2 (a different character used ONLY as style guide). Preserve Hachi's identity and apparent age, lean wiry build, short spiky black hair with orange streak, small nose bandage and freckles/scuffs, bright orange weathered hooded jacket, blue inner shirt, dark gloves, blue shoulder messenger bag and curved crowbar. Keep the original clothing, equipment, silhouette and orange-black palette. No giant anime eyes, no thick cartoon outlines, no plastic gloss, no harsh orange rim light. FOUR equal waist-up cutouts in a 2x2 grid, same torso and camera angle in every cell, complete hair/shoulders/upper arms and waist belt visible, crowbar held low naturally. Top left friendly mischievous grin, top right focused determination, bottom left surprised concern, bottom right subdued sadness. Head top and waist line must align across the four cells. Leave 8 percent clear margin around each figure, no overlaps or clipped edges. Natural diffuse neutral light, real transparent alpha background. No labels or text.

Nao, the same adult woman: long brown braided ponytail, teal cropped jacket with orange-red inner lining, white ribbed high-neck top, orange shoulder strap and belt, dark trousers and medical bag. Preserve her identity, adult age, practical clothing coverage and medical role. Replace oversized anime eyes, exaggerated jaw and drawn outlines with believable individual human facial anatomy; remain recognizable and do not beautify everyone into the same generic face. Matte skin, natural hair, soft neutral diffuse lighting, no oily gloss and no strong orange rim. Produce an evenly aligned 2x2 sheet of FOUR separate portraits of the SAME person: top left warm, top right determined, bottom left alarm, bottom right quiet grief. Same torso pose, camera scale, clothing, head size and waist baseline in all four. Show full waist-up from well above hair to just below the belt, both arms/shoulders inside cell. Preserve the existing equipment naturally in its original position. Keep at least 8 percent transparent padding around every figure with a clear empty gutter between the four cutouts. No hair or hands touching a cell boundary. Real transparent alpha, no scene, no labels, no text, no border. This is a character portrait sheet, not an action or injury scene.

Create a four-expression waist-up game character sheet of TKY. References 1 through 4 are the SAME real ADULT man and are the authoritative FACE identity. Preserve a strong recognizable likeness (the client's artistic target is about 90%, not a measured score): his narrow almond eyes, characteristic nose and relaxed mouth, rounded defined jaw, naturally dark center-parted hair falling toward the eyes. Refine him into a handsome Korean-drama-inspired STYLE through groomed eyebrows, flowing curtain hair, subtly refined natural skin, clean-shaven cheeks and confident expression; preserve the person's identity and do not substitute a celebrity or a generic idol. Reference 5 is CLOTHING AND CHARACTER BODY ONLY: preserve TKY's weathered black leather jacket, maroon-red accents and upper-arm band, dark layered shirt, diagonal shoulder strap and fingerless gloves; do not copy reference 5's old face. Render natural photographic human anatomy and materials with subtle painterly texture matching a grounded Japanese urban-survival game, neutral soft light, no harsh orange rim or plastic shine. Four evenly sized cutouts arranged 2x2: warm relaxed smile, determined, alarm/concern, quiet grief. All have the same head-to-waist camera framing, torso angle, shoulder width, clothing and face identity. Include hair top, both shoulders and arms, waist belt and upper hips; hands relaxed naturally low. Provide 8 percent clear transparent margin around every figure, no overlapping or clipped limbs. Real transparent alpha background, no scene, no labels, no text, no border. Source photos stay private; only the new illustration is a game asset.

Create a faithful illustrated portrait sheet of the SAME ADULT man in all FIVE photos. Identity fidelity is the absolute priority. The previous attempt turned him into a generic sharp-faced actor and was REJECTED. Use ONLY these real photos to define his face. Keep his actual broad rounded face and cheek volume, relatively broad jaw and soft chin, narrow softly hooded/monolid-looking eyes, natural relaxed eyebrows, distinctive nose width and rounded tip, recognizable lips and mouth width, and the long center-parted dark curtain hair falling toward one eye. Do not sharpen his jaw, hollow his cheeks, enlarge his eyes, sculpt an angular brow ridge, alter his nose, make him younger, or copy any celebrity. A slight handsome Korean-drama styling means ONLY tidier flowing hair, clean-shaven grooming and refined neutral lighting, not a different face. His recognizable likeness matters much more than idealized beauty. Clothing for his fictional game character TKY: worn black leather jacket with dark maroon-red trim and a narrow upper-arm band, loose layered black shirt, diagonal dark shoulder strap, black fingerless gloves and dark belt. Do NOT use the striped photo shirt or replace his natural face with a harsh action-hero scowl. Four equal waist-up cutouts on a 2x2 sheet with generous transparent gutters: top left his natural small friendly smile from photos 1 and 3; top right calm serious face with relaxed eyebrows; bottom left mild concern with natural eyes; bottom right quiet thoughtful downcast gaze. Same face in every cell, same head size, same clothes and camera. Show whole head/hair, shoulders and upper torso to just below waist. Subtle realistic painted finish over faithful photographic facial anatomy, natural matte skin, no anime features or plastic skin, no orange rim light. Transparent alpha background, no labels, no text, no scene.

Make ONE polished illustrated game character portrait of TKY, standing upright, waist-up, not a photo and not a four-panel sheet. References 1, 2 and 3 show the SAME ADULT real man and define his individual face; reference 4 is the approved game costume and painting style ONLY. FACE: preserve the recognizable relatively narrow relaxed eyes, the spacing and shape of his eyebrows, characteristic nose tip and width, his mouth/lip shape, rounded cheek and jaw proportions, and long dark center-parted curtain hair. Beautify by only a restrained amount: softly defined jaw, alert calm eyes rather than sleepy expression, groomed hair with a natural wave, clean-shaven smooth painted skin, confident slight closed-mouth smile. Handsome Korean-drama-inspired grooming, but not a generic sharp-jawed idol and not a different person's face. ART DIRECTION: actually redraw the face by hand in the coherent grounded semi-realistic painted style of reference 4; skin is painted with clean planes, subtle texture and deliberate shading, not a literal photographic face with pores glued onto illustrated clothes. Keep the eyes naturally narrow, not large anime eyes. COSTUME and BODY: preserve reference 4's fitted weathered black leather jacket with maroon trim, layered dark draped shirt, cross-body strap, maroon upper-arm band, black fingerless gloves, dark belt, upright lean athletic standing posture. No red neck cord, no striped shirt, no photo accessories, no seated pose, no hand at the face, no thick padded oversized jacket. Reference 4's old face is NOT the identity; use the real man's recognizable feature geometry. Composition: whole hair, head, shoulders and torso down to waist belt visible, arms naturally low, slight three-quarter turn, confident heroic game portrait. Neutral soft studio light with controlled painted edge highlights; no glowing rim. Real transparent alpha background with ample margin, no scenery, no text, no logos. Aim between a recognizable likeness and a handsome painted character, not either rejected extreme.
